test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CHERRY’ is written as ‘CFAWPP’ and ‘LEMONS’ is written as ‘KCJQLM’. How will ‘FRUITS’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘CHERRY’ is written as ‘CFAWPP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e027cde02507496ccadfec398f5c1d6f68c935d720e39a0e8258aa8421199b9b.png] 

‘LEMONS’ is written as ‘KCJQLM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9001ce56674e729d5886471181de58ffcd69457ddc0c54a6764fc94dfdbef055.png] 

Similarly, ‘FRUITS’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c7415812fe95f6a6bc0e7d1cb6beee32fe794d9301bf8d933755bea82bf6528.png] 

Hence,** 'option 3' **is the correct answer.
